shortDescription: This module manages standard volumes on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: allow_hs
options.description: If specified `True`, manages the hyperswap volume by ignoring the volume type validation. Valid when I(state=present), to modify an existing volume.

options.name: autoexpand
options.description: Specifies whether thin-provisioned volume copies automatically expand their real capacities. If specified as off, works as `noautoexpand`.

options.name: buffersize
options.description: Specifies the pool capacity that the volume will reserve as a buffer for thin-provisioned and compressed volumes. Parameter 'thin' or 'compressed' must be specified to use this parameter. The default buffer size is 2%. I(thin) or I(compressed) is required when using I(buffersize). Valid when I(state=present), to create a volume.

options.name: cache
options.description: Specifies the caching options for the volume. When not specified, the default value is 'readwrite'.

options.name: cloud_account_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the cloud account name. Valid when I(enable_cloud_snapshot=true).

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP or Partition IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: compressed
options.description: Specifies that a compressed volume is to be created. Parameters 'compressed' and 'thin' are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to create a compressed volume.

options.name: deduplicated
options.description: Specifies that a deduplicated volume is to be created. Required when I(state=present), to create a deduplicated volume.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: enable_cloud_snapshot
options.description: Specify to enable or disable cloud snapshot. Valid when I(state=present), to modify an existing volume.

options.name: fromsourcevolume
options.description: Specifies the volume name or UID in the snapshot used to pre-populate clone or thinclone volume. Valid when I(state=present), to create a thinclone or clone volume. Supported from Storage Virtualize family systems from 8.6.2.0 or later. Addressing volume via UUID is supported from 9.1.0.0 or later.

options.name: grainsize
options.description: Sets the grain size for a thin-provisioned volume.

options.name: iogrp
options.description: Specifies the list of I/O group names. Group names in the list must be separated by using a comma. While creating a new volume, the first I/O group in the list is added as both cached & access I/O group, while remaining I/O groups are added as access I/O groups. This parameter supports update functionality. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a volume.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name to assign to the new volume or name/UID to manage an existing volume.

options.name: novolumegroup
options.description: If specified `True`, the volume is removed from its associated volumegroup. Parameters 'novolumegroup' and 'volumegroup' are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to modify a volume.

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name/UID of the volume during renaming. Valid when I(state=present), to rename an existing volume.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: pool
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the storage pool to use while creating the volume. This parameter is required when I(state=present), to create a volume.

options.name: preferrednode
options.description: Specifies the preferred node name that is used to access the volume. When not specified, the system selects the preferred node automatically.

options.name: size
options.description: Defines the size of the volume. This parameter can also be used to resize an existing volume. Required when I(state=present), to create or modify a volume.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates or updates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) a volume.

options.name: thin
options.description: Specifies that a thin-provisioned volume is to be created. Parameters 'thin' and 'compressed' are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to create a thin-provisioned volume.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the type of volume to create. Volume can be thinclone or clone type. Valid when I(state=present), to create a thinclone or clone volume. Supported from Storage Virtualize family systems from 8.6.2.0 or later. Also used to convert a thinclone volume to clone. type = clone should be specified.

options.name: unit
options.description: Specifies the data units to use with the capacity that is specified by the 'size' parameter. I(size) is required when using I(unit).

options.name: unmap
options.description: Removes specified objects associated with the volume which is to be deleted. Valid when I(state=absent), to delete a volume.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.

options.name: volumegroup
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the volumegroup to which the volume is to be added. Parameters 'volumegroup' and 'novolumegroup' are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a volume.

options.name: warning
options.description: Raises a warning when the used disk capacity on the thin-provisioned copy first exceeds the specified threshold. The value is specified as a percentage of the total capacity of the thin-provisioned volume, hence it must be between 0 and 100. When not specified, the default value is 80%. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a thin-provisioned or compressed volume.
